title: A magyar nemzeti értékek és örökség (Consolidation)
grammar: Comprehensive review of Hungarian culture, science, and national heritage

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can talk about Hungarian science, inventions, music, literature and Hungarikums.
I can use *-ként* and *-vá/-vé* to say what someone or something is known as or declared.
I can read a longer text about Hungarian culture, science and heritage.
I can answer simple questions about Hungarian culture and science.
